title: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
claim: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi — OpenAI-compatible proxy that stacks the free tiers of 28 LLM providers (~4B tokens/month) behind one /v1 endpoint — plus
why_good: FreeLLMAPI aggregates free tiers from 29 LLM providers, offering 358 endpoints behind one API. It dynamically routes requests to the best available model while managing rate limits and usage caps seamlessly.
value: AI developers and startups pay for robust access to a vast array of LLMs without the overhead of managing multiple API keys and SDKs.
risk: The reliance on the free tiers of multiple providers poses a risk; if a major provider changes its free tier policy or limits access, it could disrupt service.
does: FreeLLMAPI aggregates free tiers from 29 LLM providers, offering 358 endpoints behind one API. It dynamically routes requests to the best available model while managing rate limits and usage caps seamlessly.
edge: Its unique router automatically updates from a signed feed, ensuring users always access the latest models and quotas without manual intervention.
why_use: Choose FreeLLMAPI to eliminate the hassle of managing multiple SDKs and rate limits, all while maximizing your free token usage across various providers.
hook: Unlock 4 billion tokens per month with a single OpenAI-compatible API endpoint.

zh.claim: 通过单一的 OpenAI 兼容 API 端点解锁每月 40 亿个令牌。
zh.hook: 通过单一的 OpenAI 兼容 API 端点解锁每月 40 亿个令牌。
zh.does: FreeLLMAPI 将 29 个 LLM 提供商的免费层聚合在一起，提供 358 个端点，背后只有一个 API。它动态路由请求到最佳可用模型，同时无缝管理速率限制和使用上限。
zh.edge: 其独特的路由器自动从签名源更新，确保用户始终访问最新的模型和配额，无需手动干预。
zh.why_use: 选择 FreeLLMAPI 消除管理多个 SDK 和速率限制的麻烦，同时最大化您在各个提供商之间的免费令牌使用。
zh.value: AI 开发者和初创公司为强大的访问支付，以便在不管理多个 API 密钥和 SDK 的情况下访问大量 LLM。
zh.risk: 依赖多个提供商的免费层存在风险；如果主要提供商更改其免费层政策或限制访问，可能会中断服务。
zh.why_good: FreeLLMAPI 将 29 个 LLM 提供商的免费层聚合在一起，提供 358 个端点，背后只有一个 API。它动态路由请求到最佳可用模型，同时无缝管理速率限制和使用上限。

pick_reason: The project offers a valuable aggregation service for LLM APIs, addressing a clear market need with potential for monetization.
